  • Method Details

    • getTasks

      public org.springframework.data.domain.Page<TaskResponse> getTasks(TaskStatus status, String search, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Searches and retrieves tasks matching optional filter criteria in paginated form.

      Beginner Tip - JPA Specification and JDK 22+ Unnamed Variable: Specification<TaskEntity> lets us build dynamic SQL WHERE clauses at runtime. In (root, _, cb) -> ..., _ is an unnamed variable representing the unused CriteriaQuery parameter (a modern Java feature to indicate an unused lambda parameter). root represents the TaskEntity table columns, and cb is the CriteriaBuilder providing SQL comparison operators (e.g. equal, like).

      Specified by:
      getTasks in interface TaskService
      Parameters:
      status - optional status filter (e.g. TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE)
      search - optional case-insensitive keyword to match in the title
      pageable - pagination parameters (page number, page size, sort order)
      Returns:
      a paginated page of task response DTOs

    • updateTask

      @Transactional public TaskResponse updateTask(Long id, UpdateTaskRequest request)
      Updates an existing task entity.

      Beginner Tip - Automatic Dirty Checking: Notice that we do not call taskRepository.save(task)! Within a @Transactional method, Hibernate automatically tracks mutations made to managed entities and flushes the SQL UPDATE statement to the database on commit.

      Specified by:
      updateTask in interface TaskService
      Parameters:
      id - the primary key ID of the task to update
      request - validated input payload with new values
      Returns:
      the updated task response DTO
